title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Stop Losses, Targets, and Risk-to-Reward

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of a stop loss order?
options: To lock in profits at a predetermined level
To automatically exit a trade to limit loss at a predefined price
To increase leverage on a position
To guarantee a profit regardless of market movement
questions.explanation: A stop loss is an automated exit order that sells to cut loss at a predefined price.

questions.text: Position size is calculated by dividing total risk by risk per share, where risk per share equals entry price minus stop loss price.
questions.explanation: Position size = total risk divided by risk per share (entry minus stop).
